experiment_data.hypothesis: Fast-DetectGPT (Mitchell et al. 2023) perturbation discrepancy scores, when calibrated to 4-class ordinal depth via equal-width/CORAL/threshold methods, achieve near-chance accuracy on full 9-cell atlas. Extends detectgpt_ordinal_baseline_002 (8/9 cells, 29.1%) to include pythia_nucleus. Confirms perturbation-based binary detection lacks ordinal resolution.
